name: Introduction to Computational Materials Science
description: Review of linear algebra: vectors, matrices, functions, eigen values and eigen vectors; tensors and its applications in materials science. Vector calculus for different geometries – linear and planes, directional derivative, gradients; partial differentiation – properties and solution techniques; ordinary differential equations (ODEs): analytical and numerical solution methods of ODEs; introduction to multiscale methods in simulations, modelling at atomistic scale, molecular dynamics, Monte Carlo simulations, molecular thermodynamics, phase-field modelling, finite element methods, density functional theory (DFT) for materials modelling and properties. Data analysis: probability and statistics - computing probability, smoothening and reconciliation of data, concept and parameters of distribution, regression analysis (linear and non-linear), error estimation and analysis, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing and machine learning methods in materials science.
